promise: The Seine will be swimmable for the 2024 Paris Olympics, and "we will swim in it" (I will swim in the Seine in 2024).
description: Following a 2018 EUR1.4B cleanup plan, Macron repeatedly pledged in 2023-2024 that the Seine would host Olympic swimming and that he would personally swim in it. His planned July 31, 2024 swim was cancelled, the men's triathlon was postponed a day over water quality, and several athletes fell ill — but the triathlons and marathon swimming were ultimately held in the river, and the Seine reopened to public swimming in 2025.
evidence: Macron's planned July 2024 Seine swim was cancelled
Men's triathlon postponed due to bacterial contamination (July 30, 2024)
Marathon swimming events took place in the Seine in August 2024; river reopened to swimmers July 2025

promise: Paris 2024 will be the first Olympic Games with full gender parity on the field of play (as reported).
description: IOC pledged that Paris 2024 would be the first fully gender-balanced Games. The Paris 2024 Games fielded exactly 5,250 women and 5,250 men (50/50), fulfilling the target.
evidence: IOC confirmed equal number of female and male athlete slots at Paris 2024

promise: Tesla Robotaxi will be unveiled on 8/8/24
description: Musk announced in April 2024 that Tesla would unveil its Robotaxi on 8/8/24. The reveal was postponed for design changes and finally took place on October 10, 2024, when Tesla introduced the Cybercab robotaxi and Robovan at its 'We, Robot' event in Burbank, California.
evidence: Reveal moved from August 8 to October 10, 2024
Cybercab unveiled at the 'We, Robot' event on October 10, 2024
